title: M7 original charged scalar arithmetic and factorized mask-loop bounds

spec.name: M7.ScalarWork.term_bound
spec.statement: ∀ (N D k : ℕ) (W : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → D ≤ N → k ≤ N → W.card ≤ N → M7.ScalarWork.term D W k ≤ 128 * N^4
spec.guidance:
Original M7 deliberately conservative arithmetic/mask loop charges, with explicit unit-cost scalar operation model. This does NOT claim Lean runtime/bit complexity or a free bound on arbitrary evaluators. The exact term loops mirror ArithmeticSubset.binomialTerm: one target character and both negativeCount W scans for each j, with fixed scalar arithmetic overhead. Polynomial/coordinate/binomial preprocessing and integer bit costs stay additional finite costs. Prove term_bound by reducing the constant range sum and bounding D,k,cardW by positive N; use simple intermediate linear/product inequalities before nlinarith or omega. prefix_bound follows the actual overfull guard and the accepted ArithmeticLoops exclusion_cap, factor_card, divisor_card. Restricted WA/WB are subsets of range N via Base, hence card≤N; deficits≤w≤N. Each term is ≤128*N^4 and 2^degree≤2^N; the 16 overhead is absorbed in 1024*N^4*2^N. Bound the actual powerset/divisor sums by cardinalities, then sector sum. Preserve full multiplicities and empty E. mask_positions is the literal unit/exchange/two SINGLE-shift loops visiting N mask coordinates each; use Fintype.card_prod, Bool.card, ZMod.card and sum_const. This is original O(phi*N^2), not a pair-support scan. Return tactic lines only.
import M7ArithmeticLoopsAccepted
import M7ActualFactorizedAccepted

namespace M7.ScalarWork
open scoped BigOperators
/-- Unit-cost signed scalar arithmetic after coordinate and binomial preprocessing.
    Four operations per binary character coordinate, plus scalar setup. -/
def character (D : ℕ) : ℕ := 1 + 4*D
/-- Each negativeCount scans W and evaluates its character and sign test. -/
def negative (D : ℕ) (W : Finset ℕ) : ℕ := W.card * (2 + character D)
/-- Direct evaluation of the existing j-sum, including both occurrences of negativeCount.
    No constant-subexpression caching or bit-complexity improvement is assumed. -/
def term (D : ℕ) (W : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  character D + ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range (k+1), (8 + 2 * negative D W)
/-- The existing guarded divisor/exclusion/character loops with per-term scalar charges.
    Polynomial factorization, coordinate preprocessing, binomials and integer bit costs
    remain explicit additional finite costs, as in original M7 section 11. -/
noncomputable def prefixWork (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial)
    (A B WA WB : Finset ℕ) : ℕ := by
  classical
  exact if A.card ≤ w ∧ B.card ≤ w then
    ∑ d ∈ (M5.Connectivity.supportGcd N A B).divisors,
      ∑ S ∈ (M5.PolynomialExclusion.residualFactors (M5.cyclicModulus N) F).powerset,
        16 + 2^(F * (∏ p ∈ S, p)).natDegree *
          (term (F * (∏ p ∈ S, p)).natDegree (M5.ConditionalCount.restricted WA d) (w-A.card) +
           term (F * (∏ p ∈ S, p)).natDegree (M5.ConditionalCount.restricted WB d) (w-B.card))
    else 0
noncomputable def sector (N w : ℕ) (E : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial)
    (A B WA WB : Finset ℕ) : ℕ := ∑ F ∈ E, prefixWork N w F A B WA WB
/-- Coordinate-position visits in the two independent full single-block mask scans. -/
noncomputable def maskPositions (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : ℕ :=
  ∑ _u : M7.ActualFactorized.Outer N, ((∑ _s : ZMod N, N) + (∑ _t : ZMod N, N))
end M7.ScalarWork

spec.name: M7.ScalarWork.prefix_bound
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (A B WA WB : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → w ≤ N → M7.PrefixCompleted.Base N A B WA WB → ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → M7.ScalarWork.prefixWork N w F A B WA WB ≤ 1024 * N^4 * M7.ArithmeticLoops.divisorCount N * 2^(M7.ArithmeticLoops.factorCount N + N)
